formal_boundaries.positive: Reciprocal candidate membership plus the displayed parthood/explanation/circle conditions yields identity of explanatory facts; all-actual-facts totality supplies membership, and nonempty unrestricted PSR supplies existence.
formal_boundaries.four_fact_control: Four facts, equality parthood, all predicate pluralities, no fusions. The narrower target excludes a,b and has exactly q,a,b as full explainers.
formal_boundaries.boolean_control: Nonempty subsets of four atoms, inclusion parthood, proper parts, strong supplementation and all nonempty fusions. This removes the first control's missing-fusion limitation while retaining local nonuniqueness.
formal_boundaries.limits: Fact identity is not bearer identity. Mereological union is not logical conjunction; no truth-negation semantics, productive-creation interpretation, injective bearer bridge, modal or metaphysical realization is claimed. Candidate exclusion permits controls; it does not force nonuniqueness in every model.
